editionData.title: Trump and Qatar’s emir discuss efforts for regional de-escalation in call; Trump says Russia-Ukraine deal is near after meeting...
editionData.description: Global headlines: Trump and Qatar’s emir discuss efforts for regional de-escalation in call (Sheikh Tamim stresses the need for continued dialogue and diplomatic solutions to spare the region further escalation); Trump says Russia-Ukraine deal is near after meeting Putin’s envoy (Though the US president said deal was 'very close', he gave no specifics and did not meet visiting Ukrainian delegation); and Israeli settlers seize 8 Palestinian homes in Jericho, displacing dozens (UN says settlers reportedly used live ammunition and beat Palestinians, forcing families to flee for their safety). Markets leaned higher, with 7 of 7 tracked indexes up; S&P 500 up 0.00% was the largest move. Benchmarks tracked: S&P 500, NASDAQ Composite, Euronext 100 Index, and Public Joint-Stock Company Moscow Exchange MICEX-RTS plus 3 more indexes. Hacker News: Blender's UI and Runtime: Much Faster Than GPUI (Blender's GPU Accelerated UI, Decoupled from it's original codebase. Supports Rust, Python, JS, React, C & C++. Twice as good as GPUI -...); Claude Code sends your email address to websites (Bug Description I receive dozens of scam emails per day because claude code divulged my email to arbitrary 3rd parties in the User-Agent...); and sshole (openssh on musl linux has been letting people into password-less accounts since 2016). Product Hunt features Cursor Craft (Custom cursors for Mac), Releasebeam (Release infrastructure for developers), and TraceX (The AI engineer for your production issues).

headlines.summary: Putin meets Iran's top security official to discuss regional security and receives a letter from Mojtaba Khamenei.

headlines.title: A judge blocks construction of Trump's arch moments after it won federal approval
headlines.summary: The Trump administration hoped to begin construction immediately after a federal panel approved its arch late Thursday. But just after midnight, the judge issued an order blocking work for 14 days.

headlines.title: Fears of an AI crackdown after midterms spark $2 trillion rout in tech stocks
headlines.summary: Shares sank, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq dropping over 5%, as investors reacted with fear that a Democratic Congress — and states across the country -— would crack down on AI and data centers.

headlines.title: These are the races in the House and Senate that haven't been called yet
headlines.summary: Democrats are poised to have a strong majority in the upcoming Congress. The final numbers are still being determined. Here's where things stand in the races that are waiting to be called by the AP.

headlines.title: Melania Trump touts rare agreement she brokered between Russia and Ukraine
headlines.summary: The six-day pause from the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky comes as the administration ramps up efforts to secure an agreement to end the war in Ukraine.

headlines.title: How North Carolina Democrats flipped several House seats in historically GOP districts
headlines.summary: All of these seats were in districts redrawn in 2023 to favor Republican candidates.

headlines.title: Major changes in US foreign policy 'unlikely'
headlines.summary: As a decisive blue wave sweeps the United States in the midterm elections, with the Democrats winning clear majorities in both the Senate and the House of Representatives, analysts expect stronger scrutiny of the administration led by US President Donald Trump, but noted that the shift in congressional power may not necessarily effect major changes in the US' foreign policy.

headlines.title: Trump touts 'big' Ukraine deal after meeting Russian envoy
headlines.summary: WASHINGTON -- US President Donald Trump said Thursday that "a big agreement" to end the Russia-Ukraine conflict could be reached soon and might involve all of Europe.

headlines.title: Japan's defense spending surge raises concerns
headlines.summary: As Japan faces mounting economic and fiscal pressures, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's administration is considering nearly doubling defense spending over the next five years, a move analysts warn could heighten regional tensions and further strain household budgets.

headlines.title: Turkish parliament approves Mecca Joint Defense Agreement with Pakistan, Saudi Arabia
headlines.summary: The General Assembly of the Grand National Assembly of Türkiye on Thursday approved a bill on the ratification of the Mecca Joint Defense Agreement among Türkiye, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia, local media reported.

headlines.title: UN warns global adaptation efforts lag behind escalating climate risks
headlines.summary: As climate change intensifies, exposing communities and economies to increasingly severe floods, droughts, and extreme heat, global efforts to adapt are struggling to keep pace, according to a new United Nations report.

headlines.title: Form 8 must be decided during SIR; deletion without hearing denies vote: Bombay HC
